backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types and CRUD operations for questions, user profiles, subscription plans, and arrays, with role-based access control (admin/user) enforced via an AccessControl mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single fix (REQ-34) for invisible correct-answer text in QuizScreen.tsx and ReviewScreen.tsx, specifying high-contrast bold styling for highlighted options.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary file describing the purpose and key changes of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes including background, primary, destructive, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root into a div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing global screen navigation state across all app screens, conditionally rendering the persistent AppHeader and the appropriate page component, wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Sticky app header component featuring a kebab (3-dot) dropdown navigation menu linking to all major screens, with active-state highlighting and outside-click dismissal.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Defines the Question interface, topic/year constants, and a large static array of Unani medicine quiz questions with options, correct answers, and explanations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching admin questions, adding new questions to the backend, and merging backend questions with static local questions for app-wide use.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for storing and retrieving quiz attempt history on the ICP backend, encoding/decoding attempts as arrays of bigints.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionQuerie: Provides a React Query hook to fetch available subscription plans from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines light/dark theme CSS custom properties for a parchment/teal color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Password-protected admin panel screen that allows adding new quiz questions to the backend and listing existing ones, with form validation and feedback messages.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's quiz attempt history with summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and a list of past results. Includes a clear history button that calls the backend actor's clearArray method.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: Renders the app home screen with a hero banner, stats row, and navigation cards for starting a quiz, browsing topics/years, viewing history, subscription plans, and the admin panel.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentMethodSelector: Provides a payment method selection UI (UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, wallets) for subscribing to a plan, with a mock payment flow that shows a success confirmation screen.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Implements the interactive quiz interface with question navigation, answer selection with immediate correct/incorrect feedback, and a progress bar, calling onComplete when the last question is answered.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows quiz results including score percentage, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, time taken, and a topic breakdown, while recording the attempt to the backend on mount.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Displays a post-quiz answer review screen, showing each question with the user's answer and the correct answer highlighted, along with correct/incorrect/skipped status badges and navigation between questions.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPlansScre: Renders a subscription plans page with monthly and yearly plan options, a toggle to switch between them, feature lists, and a button to navigate to the payment screen.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Provides a browsable question list organized by topic or year, fetching questions from the backend and allowing users to start a shuffled quiz from any topic or year group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, an extended color palette using OKLCH CSS variables, border radii, box shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state including version, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of existing features for the AIAPGET Unani MCQ practice app.
